description: Request and response signatures (wire 7.1) and the push webhook (wire 8.2). Request fields are the exact header texts, empty when absent, and the method as sent; the timestamp is RFC 3339 UTC to the second. Each response names the request case it answers in request (null for an unsigned public read) and gives the request as the service received it in received_request: lp(method, path and query, body field, Dispatch origin, H(Dispatch-Identity), H(Dispatch-App), H(Dispatch-Cert), H(Dispatch-Invite-Code), H(Dispatch-Transfer), H(Dispatch-Timestamp), H(Dispatch-Signature), H(Dispatch-Created)), the body field BLAKE3(body) once the body is read, each H empty when the header is absent and lp of its values when present, every H empty for the public read. Response signatures cover u64(status), BLAKE3 of the received request, the exact Dispatch-Server-Time text, the head field (empty without Dispatch-Head, BLAKE3 of its exact text with one) and BLAKE3(body).
